description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Dating: Late, maybe 14th–16th century. The upper heading on the recto mentions a year but its meaning is not completely clear. The final word is alf (1000) and the one preceding that may be a misspelling of 2 (th..nayn?), so at a minimum the document is later than 1000 AH (1591/92 CE) but this dating requires further examination based on the paleography (which seems earlier).
description_he: חשבונות ביהודית-ערבית. תאריך: מאוחר, אולי המאה ה-14-16. נדרשת בדיקה.
